title: Pattern avoidance in permutations and their rotations
summary: A rotation of a permutation is a new permutation obtained by moving the first several terms of the permutation to the end of the permutation. A circular permutation is the set of all rotations of a permutation. The enumerations of permutations and circular permutations avoiding patterns of length three and four are well studied.
